facts.text: IKARETControlVisc is the class for the IKA RET control-visc hotplate stirrer and implements the English manual's serial command set
The serial line is opened at 9600 baud with seven data bits, even parity and RTS/CTS flow control

The command set uses IN_PV_1/IN_SP_1/OUT_SP_1 and START_1/STOP_1 for sensor 1, IN_PV_4/IN_SP_4/OUT_SP_4 and START_4/STOP_4 for the stirrer, START_80/STOP_80 for the pH meter, START_90/STOP_90 for weighing and RESET for the reset
temperature_pv and temperature_sp address sensor 1, the medium (external) temperature sensor; the setter logs the set point in degrees Celsius
stir_rate_pv and stir_rate_sp address the stirrer rate; the setter logs RPM and converts the value to an integer
temperature_hot_plate_pv and temperature_hot_plate_sp address sensor 2, the hot plate temperature
get_ph reads IN_PV_80 and get_weight reads IN_PV_90; the weight needs the weighing function started and takes about four seconds to calibrate
temperature_hot_plate_safety_sp reads the hot plate safety set point and has no setter
controlTemperature documents the target temperature as room temperature to 340 Celsius
controlStirrer documents the target stir rate as 0 to 1700 rpm
controlStop stops the stirrer and then the heater
set_watch_dog_temp, set_watch_dog_stir_rate, get_hot_plate_temp_current and get_viscosity_trend are empty methods in the upstream class and are not exposed
SerialDevice raises OSError on an operating system other than Windows
The command decorator queues each call to a background thread and blocks the caller until the reply is queued
